turns.text: Also, if you look at the map, you'll notice a few cafes along the way.
turns.zh: 还有，你看地图的话，会注意到沿途有几家咖啡店。

turns.text: There's a nice one just before the park.
turns.zh: 公园前面就有一家不错的。

turns.text: I might stop for a quick coffee.
turns.zh: 我可能会停下来快速喝杯咖啡。

turns.text: They serve excellent pastries as well.
Is the area safe to walk around?
